notes.title: A collaboration of the "Tsugunohi" series. "Zombie Scream" available today!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399277/e9314988e266f3fff71c0df4706675143b2cf250.png[/img]

The Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese versions of "Zombie Scream" are released today!
The price is 560 yen.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1971100/

"Zombie Scream" was created in 2020 in response to a request from Japanese video creator Odaken, who had been playing ImCyan's classic horror game "Tsugunohi" series.
At the time, Odaken was the only one who had played the game and posted a video of the game in action, which became a topic of conversation.

Now, a little over a year later, this title is coming to Steam!
A "costume system" has been added to change the main character's outfit, as well as new episodes and a new ending.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399277/725c7086772193f5951b9104994c3ecf72b8738e.png[/img]

The basic operation is to move the main character to the left, so anyone can play easily.
Now, why don't you experience the "strange world" for yourself?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399277/6b83f92419c7a51f3312a2ab486e5fcefe800806.png[/img]


Story
In an apartment on the outskirts of town, Let's Play creator, Odaken, has carved a life out for himself uploading videos where he plays games.
Yet without even realizing it, his peaceful life is gradually taking an unsettling new direction, one where a great terror lies in wait…


Profile
• Tsugunohi Series
ImCyan has released many horror games as an indie game creator and is best known for his Tsugunohi series. The first entry in the series was branded "terrifying" online all the way back in 2012, after which Tsugunohi - A Closed Future - earned massive popularity, mainly as the subject of other creators' Let's Plays, on YouTube in Summer 2018. The series became so popular that international fans have even translated it into Chinese and Korean.
Twitter▶@imcyan00aeef

• Odaken
Odaken uploads Let's Play videos that mainly feature horror and joke games and is known for his lively commentary.
He also uploads videos of himself playing piano, one of his many other talents.
Twitter▶@odakento_1


© UUUM/ODAKEN/ImCyan/Vaka, Inc.

notes.title: A collaboration of the "Tsugunohi" series. "Zombie Scream" on sale tomorrow!
notes.notes:
The "Tsugunohi" series (author ImCyan) and Japanese video creator Odaken have collaborated to create "Zombie Scream," which will be released tomorrow, June 3, 14:00(JST)!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1971100/

This work attracted attention in 2020 when only Odaken-san played the game and posted an actual video.
The Steam version has a "costume system" that allows you to change the main character's costume, a "new episode" and a "new ending," so even those who have seen the actual video can enjoy a new horror experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42399277/e9314988e266f3fff71c0df4706675143b2cf250.png[/img]

Stay tuned for the release!

■"Tsugunohi" is also available on Steam.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1322300/
